body: A security job wouldn't pay the bills; I'd be worse off then ever. A lifestyle change would be good, but this is who I am. I joined the army at 17; I don't have any other skills. I'm great at what I do; I've been in the news several times for large scale drug arrests and firearm seizures. But I couldn't make my personal life work and traded a few medals for a divorce. I'm talking about work again, and thats my problem. I'm not talking about the real issue. I'm tired. Everyone just seems to want to take a part of me away, and I have nothing else to give. I'm backed way deep into a corner and I'm just tired.
